name: Escalation Ammunition
text:
Ammunition any

Activate 1 (manipulate)

---
Malevolent arcane energy leaks from within escalation ammunition, sizzling with barely restrained contempt. When activated escalation ammunition hits a target, the target must attempt a DC 30 Fortitude save save. On a failure, the target rolls the next saving throw it attempts within the next minute against a spell or magical effect twice and takes the worse result.

Effect: Escalation Ammunition
